errors.text_span: Хоризонталната ос показва държавите... Вертикалната ос измерва процента
errors.evidence: The chart is a horizontal bar chart where the countries (categories) are listed on the vertical axis and the percentage values are shown on the horizontal axis. The description incorrectly swaps the two axes.
The bars representing the countries are sorted in descending order based on their numerical value, not alphabetically.
The country with the highest value of 21.2 is Нидерландия (Netherlands), not Словакия (Slovakia). Slovakia's value is 19.2.

errors.text_span: няма визуални отличителни бележки, които да подчертават отделни стойности
errors.evidence: This statement is incorrect. The bars are clearly distinguished by two different colors (red and blue), which constitutes a visual distinction.
